notes.title: Release 2.15
notes.content:
Greetings Team,

Update 2.15 is now live for Windows and Mac. It fixes some bugs, comes with two notable changes:

1. Data Structures and Enums

You can define your data structures (structs/classes/MonoBehaviours/...) from Ed, and assign them to TileDefs. This generates C# code when exporting to Unity, and helps with attaching components to different tiles.

2. Unity Improvements

When you import your EdTech package in Unity, you'll now see the EdTech menu right on the main menu bar. Under it, there are menu entries that quickly spawn different levels of your Ed package.
